title: pr_info on every successful INIT dispatch will spam dmesg at scale
description: ioctl_init changed 'pr_debug(init dispatched to provider)' to 'pr_info'. Every crypto2dev session open now emits a pr_info line. An application doing AES-CBC streaming at any reasonable throughput — even a few hundred sessions/second — will flood /var/log/kern.log. pr_info is not ratelimited. This is 2025 usage of dmesg as a chatty session log, not a kernel info event. Trigger: application opens many crypto2dev sessions. Expected impact: dmesg/kern.log rotation on heavily loaded systems; pr_info messages per session are not rate-limited so they are not suppressed under load.
